name: Planisware SAS
summary: Planisware SAS operates as a business-to-business software-as-a-service provider in Europe, North America, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It offers Planisware Enterprise, an integrated solution that brings together budgets, forecasts, schedules, resources, and actuals; Planisware Orchestra, a turnkey cloud solution to quickly streamline project decision-making, foster collaboration and ensure best practice across organization; artificial intelligence platform; integrations and APIs; and platform and cloud services.
